props.name: scopeRef
props.description: Region the aura lives in. Omit and it follows the whole document.

props.name: target
props.description: Selector for elements the aura snaps to and wraps.

props.name: ease
props.description: How quickly it catches up, 0 to 1. Lower is heavier.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour for the glow.

props.name: labels
props.description: Read `data-aura` off the hovered target and show it inside the aura.

props.name: invert
props.description: Invert what is underneath instead of tinting it.
